cues.text: Welcome to the metals lab. You have five unknown samples, seven tests and a limited budget. Predict every result before you test, and watch out for samples that break the rules.
First impressions. Click each sample and say whether you think it is a metal or a non-metal. You can change your mind later.
Impressions locked in. Now test them. Pick a test, then click a sample, and predict the result before every run.
Prediction locked. Now run it and see what really happens.
That is not what you predicted, and that is fine. Surprises are where the learning happens. Think about why.
Only three test runs are left. Choose them carefully: which sample are you least sure about?
Every sample has a decision and enough tests. When you are ready, submit to see what they really were.
Here is what the samples really were. Look closely at any exceptions, and at any call you would change now.
